thread:
sam-sales: Quick sync - BlueHarbor sent a custom fine-tune 'cerulean-13b-ft-v2' (HF checkpoint + custom BPE). They're requesting a 30-day POC to validate latency/cost for an embedding+rereank flow. Can eng/ML confirm catalog compatibility?

ritesh-ml: What are their perf targets and pkgs?
sam-sales: Target: sustained 80 req/s, median < 220ms for 256-token responses, 95th < 420ms. They'll use embeddings (dense) + a small reranker, ~3 calls per user action.

anya-eng: That sustained qps is non-trivial. For 13B with 2048 ctx in fp16 on L4s we need multiple nodes with steady batching. If they accept an int8 quant variant we can drop infra by ~40%. Need to know tokenizer avg tokens per prompt.

ritesh-ml: We should also check that their tokenizer produces no pathological long-token spikes. Ask them for a 500-sample tokenization dump. Also: adapter layers in their FT? That affects weight layout and potential kernel fallback.
sam-sales: Confirmed: small adapter + custom BPE; they'll share 500 samples and a model card. They asked if Redwood supports BYOK KMS for model weights and request audit logs.

legal-bot: Note: BYOK for model artifacts is an enterprise-only flow (Private/Dedicated). I'll need model provenance + third-party license declarations. Also flag: retention of logs > 180d is an add-on.

anya-eng: Proposed rollout plan: create two temporary catalog entries: cerulean-13b-ft-v2-fp16 and cerulean-13b-ft-v2-int8. Route 75% traffic to int8. Keep a canary fp16 route. Enable prefix KV cache for repeated contexts.

infra-bot: DEPLOY CHECKS: [MODEL_BUNDLE_VALID], [TOKENIZER_SAMPLE_RECEIVED], [KV_PREFIX_ENABLED], [QUANT_BUILD], [BYOK_VERIFIED], [AUDIT_LOG_REQ]

ritesh-ml: Eval plan (short):
- run end-to-end rerank pipeline on their 1k sample set in fp16 and int8
- compute nDCG/recall@k and token-level divergence
- run 200 stateful sessions to exercise KV prefix correctness
- surface any sample with tokenization drift > 12%

sam-sales: Pricing question: they want hosted estimate vs Dedicated reserved 2x L4s for 30 days. Can infra provide quick cost delta?

anya-eng: Quick back-of-envelope: hosted shared nodes for that QPS may be ~ $0.20 per gen-token-hour at 256 avg, Dedicated reserved 2xL4s amortized looks ~ 45% lower for sustained 30-day. I'll produce a calc if they confirm batching targets (batch=6).

ritesh-ml: Risk note: If tokenizer mismatch causes longer tokenization our batching efficiency drops and cost/latency worsen. Suggest we include a small tokenizer alignment step: we ship their BPE vocab through our tokenizer-sanity tool and run remap heuristics.

sam-sales: Action items: 
- sam: request 500 tokenization samples + model card + license statements (sent)
- ritesh: run quality + KV tests on 1k set, report delta by EOD tomorrow
- anya: perf sketch + hosted vs dedicated pricing roughs by EOD tomorrow
- legal-bot: draft security questionnaire addendum for BYOK + retention terms

rita-ml: (later) posted quick eval: int8 delta on nDCG ~0.8% drop, token divergence mean 0.4%, KV pass 98/100. Two failing sessions are due to whitespace tokenization differences. Recommend tokenizer-sanity patch + proceed with int8 primary.

sam-sales: Great, scheduling a POC kickoff call for Tue. Thanks everyone :rocket:
